_comment: steel-cutlist job template. Copy, fill in, and delete the _comment keys. Lengths: provide exactly one of length_in or length_ft per entry; length_ft accepts a number (28.5) or a feet-inches string ("28'-6").

settings._comment: kerf_in: band saw ~0.06, cold saw ~0.09, abrasive ~0.19. end_trim_in applies per bar end. Drops >= min_drop_in are reported as reusable candidates.

members._comment: unit_weight_plf is optional; when omitted the bundled AISC database is consulted by designation.
members.name: C1

stock._comment: Finite quantities model on-hand material or vendor availability. Use exactly one cost basis: cost_per_ft or cost_per_bar.
